label: Aristotle, Metaphysics VIII.6, 1045a23–33…: Aristotle answers the unity puzzle by treating the…
interpretation: Prose reading of the affirmative H.6 proposal, not a proof that every organized system instantiates it. Same and one are qualified by potentiality and actuality; this does not identify matter and form without qualification, define a material arrangement as a substance, or import a Thomistic essence–esse distinction.
